messages:
claire_cs: Quick sync — Flicker Labs onboarding: we've seen tail latency spikes during demo traffic and they're due for renewal in ~8w. Want to propose a proactive perf plan (quant + model routing) before renewal talks.

lizzy_success: Got it. Can you paste the perf samples? I'll flag renewal risk if we don't improve.

claire_cs: Pasted logs below (excerpt). p50 ~120ms, p95 jumps to 2.6s under bursts. Looks like long sequences + cache misses.

diego_infra: Saw the traces. Agree it's KV cache churn with heavy multi-turn. Quick recs: 1) route bursty traffic to a smaller, quantized variant 2) enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts 3) canary for 48h.

sam_ml: +1. Modeling note: compact-v1-int8 reduces latency ~35% and cost ~40% for this workload. Expected quality delta: ~5–12% on Flicker's eval prompts depending on length. Recommend hybrid routing:
- steady traffic -> base-v2 (FP16)
- burst windows (>75th qps) -> compact-v1-int8
- fallback to base if quality drop detected

remy_se: Customer constraints: they want 99th <2s and will accept small accuracy hit for quick replies. I'll coordinate keys + access for private canary if needed.

claire_cs: Can we get a short playbook + canary steps I can share w/ customer next week? Need to show expected latency and cost delta for renewal meeting.

diego_infra: Putting a config snippet together. Will canary at 10% for 24h then 30% for 24h if metrics look good. Snippet:```json
{"routing_policy":"burst_to_compact","canary_steps":[{"pct":10,"duration":"24h"},{"pct":30,"duration":"24h"}],"models":{"base":"base-v2","compact":"compact-v1-int8"},"monitoring":{"p95_threshold_ms":2000,"quality_check":"prompt-set-eval"}}
```

sam_ml: I'll run a quick A/B eval on their 200-sample prompt set overnight and post delta metrics (exact EM/BLEU-ish proxies + human-flagged examples). ETA ~48h.

lizzy_success: Awesome — I'll draft a short ROI blurb: predicted cost savings + latency improvement and note the small quality tradeoff. Means we have a clear renewal ask.

claire_cs: Thanks. @redwood-bot can you create a ticket with this plan and assign to diego_infra + sam_ml? Add due date in 2 weeks.

redwood-bot: Ticket created: CS-8723 - flicker-perf-canary. Assignees: diego_infra, sam_ml. Due: 2026-04-10.

diego_infra: Kicking off canary config in staging now, will post any infra issues in #eng-runtime and update ticket.

sam_ml: Started eval run — will share summary + 10 example diffs when done.

lizzy_success: I'll prep the renewal note and include the metrics and the canary timeline.

claire_cs: Perfect — keep this thread for customer updates. If we hit any >5% quality regression we hold the rollout. :thumbsup:
